reader_rules.J2_support: each arm's own native samples on [0, its end displacement] (top and bottom force share them)
reader_rules.J3_combination: U6(c) aggregate over the judged cells 32 and 48: a valid exceedance is a mismatch, both within is a match, otherwise held (hold kind J2 when every held judged cell is a J2 hold)
reader_rules.J3_inputs: V0/4 arms, same cells, same material; the one-disk arm read at u/2 (u_G2 = 2 u_G1)
reader_rules.J5_method: continuous two-segment least squares on samples with ε >= 0, hinge at a native sample with >= 3 samples on the left and >= 2 on the right; σ_yy is taken compression positive (-recorded value)
reader_rules.decision: first row among 1-7 that is TRUE in three-valued logic (HOLD = unknown); rows still unknown above it are listed; no TRUE row -> MINI_HELD
reader_rules.lateral_watch: two-disk arms only (§4-4 names the upper disk of G2); the one-disk value is reported
reader_rules.row4_condition: J1 parts of 'converging contact X' true and J3 held only by J2 holds
reader_rules.row7_plate_condition: '(G1 수렴)' read as the plastic one-disk V0/4 J1 converged
reader_rules.technical: RELEASE or manifest differs, execution record missing, incomplete or with a retry, CPUs not two distinct physical cores, worker rc 1 or 2, or an arm whose sources, environment, affinity, threads or registered configuration differ -> TECHNICAL_INCOMPLETE, no physics

thresholds.J1: 20 N <= D on unrounded values (rule.json U6c-06, executed from force_rule.py)
